body:
Every manimvox video had the same skeleton: one title card, faded "01" chapter numerals, a header and progress bar on every frame, everything clearing to the left, recap bullets, and a still end card. The brief already asks for openings like "straight in, no title card", but no code path honoured them. This PR gives each video a direction and gives the kit the options to carry it out. **Defaults are unchanged**, so existing episodes render exactly as before.

## Skills
- New [`direction.md`](skills/manimvox-creative/references/direction.md):
  - three storylines first, one recommended;
  - then `DIRECTION.md`: a look from one medium, motion timings by role, the opening and ending shots, a transition per chapter seam, and a BANNED list of manimvox's own tells.
- Each brief opening and ending answer maps to a kit call.
- All four workflow skills run the direction step after the brief.
- The fixed opening and ending in `script.md` become options, and "videos are dark" is dropped.

## Kit (all opt-in)
- `intro(card=False)`: opens on the subject, and the title arrives over it word by word.
- `CHROME = ()`: a clean frame with no header label or progress bar.
- `chapter(transition=, keep=, number=)`:
  - `transition=`: blur, down, dip, `zoom_through`, `flood`, `iris` or `whip`;
  - `keep=`: carries objects across the seam;
  - `number=False`: drops the numeral.
- `clear(how=, keep=)`, and `outro(end=)` for a built end card.
- `kit/motion.py`: title entrances (`words_in`, `letters_in`, `blur_in`, `slot`, `accent_word`) and the transitions.
- Theme `ground` (solid, grain, grid, paper). Light backgrounds are allowed, and `check theme` notes panel roles left dark.
- Post title and end cards type in instead of holding a 3 s still.
- `check layout` notes when 3 or more chapters all use the same explicit transition.

## Blocks
`kinetic-title`, `end-card`, `transitions-demo`.

## Roadmap
0.5 becomes "directed, professor-quality visuals". The new items sit alongside leader lines, flow streams and markers. Sound effects and beat-cut music move to Later.

## Tests
- `uv run pytest`: 998 passed, 54 skipped. That includes `tests/test_directed.py` (12 tests, 3 of them slow renders, one comparing the layout output with the options left out and with the defaults spelled out).
- `ruff check src tests examples`: clean.
- The block previews are regenerated, and `zensical build --strict` reports no issues.

Not yet done: an end-to-end comparison of two real videos made with the new direction step, and a textured `ground` under `Episode3D`.
